content.title: NCAA Tournament TV schedule, or link to live stream
content.text: Skip to content Catch all the 2026 March Madness on HTC Don’t miss the HOOPla on HTC! Get a front row seat to catch all the action on HTC TV Max! The Dates for the 2026 Men’s NCAA Tournament are: Selection Sunday: March 15 First Four: March 17-18 First round: March 19-20 Second round: March 22-23 Sweet 16: March 26-27 Elite Eight: March 28-29 Final Four: April 4 & 6 (Lucas Oil Stadium, Indianapolis) NCAA championship game: April 6 (Lucas Oil Stadium, Indianapolis) Which HTC channels will broadcast March Madness?March Madness will be broadcast across four cable networks: CBS (channel 13), TBS (channel 47), TNT (channel 25) and truTV (channel 56). If you don’t get a channel, call to subscribe so you don’t miss out on the action. You can upgrade through HTC My Account or by calling 843-365-2154. How can I stream March Madness? March Madness is available for streaming on Paramount+ and can also be accessed on any streaming service with access to CBS, TBS, TNT and truTV, like YouTube TV, Sling TV and Hulu + Live TV. How can I watch March Madness for free? Many March Madness games will be broadcast on local CBS affiliates. If you have a digital antenna, you can catch the games without any subscription to cable or streaming services. Where can I find the bracket schedule?Brackets with teams, times and channels can be found at NCAA.com Looking for the women’s tournament schedule? You can find it here. Please Note: HTC is not responsible for changes to programming. Please check the TV Guide for up-to-date information on all game times and channels. All listings are Eastern Time. © 2026 HTC Inc..
